title: Privacy Glass
body:

"A toggleable glass material, useful for blinds or other secrets you want to hold!"

The Privacy Glass is a toggleable glass structure in Oaklands that allows players to switch between transparent and opaque states, making it useful for privacy-focused builds and hidden design elements. This could also be used for automation as lasers bounce off when the glass is powered while pass through if it's not. 

Default Size: 1 x 1 x 1

Min. Size:    1 × 1 × 1

Max. Size:    12 × 12 × 12
